description: Final harness adds an opt-in setvbuf control; default validation behavior and timer boundaries are unchanged. The final runner collects process I/O totals and supports reduced repetitions for large cases.
early_run: Initial suite completed 10 measured runs per backend for both small cases, with two warmups per backend per case. Stopped during the first large-case warmup due to observed I/O cost. Original executable hashes were not persisted before that stop; initial source hashes are retained in machine.json. No interrupted sample is included.
